subject: Interview playbook + focal areas for LLM Serving Lead candidate (Elena Park)
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-01-09T08:10:00-08:00
Subject: Interview playbook + focal areas for LLM Serving Lead candidate (Elena Park)

Hi team,

Quick thread to align on scope / leveling and an interview plan for Elena Park (resume attached). She's our top candidate for the LLM Serving Lead role. I sketched a lightweight playbook below so panelers have consistent expectations and scoring signals. Please review and call out any gaps — especially around failure-mode questions and rollout experience.

Proposed interview flow (90m total):
- 15m intro + product context (hiring manager)
- 35m system & operational design (scale, KV cache, multi-tenant isolation)
- 25m model-serving implementation + perf tradeoffs (quantization, batching, kernels)
- 15m behavioral / leadership + runway to production (on-call, playbooks, incident examples)

Key leveling signals to look for (senior vs staff):
- Ownership: single-service ownership vs cross-service platform ownership
- Abstraction: designs that protect downstream apps and support multiple model families
- Cost/throughput tradeoffs: clear examples of unit-cost decisions and measurement
- Mentorship & hiring: track record onboarding engineers and raising bar

Rubric highlights (use attached template):
- System design (0-5) — correctness, tradeoffs, constraints handling
- Implementation depth (0-5) — kernel/runtime awareness, latency/throughput levers
- Production ops (0-5) — SLOs, runbooks, rollback strategies
- Leadership & collaboration (0-5) — cross-team influence, mentoring examples

Logistics: I attached a set of interview slots (interview-slot-options.ics). If that schedule works we'll send calendar invites and the candidate a single invite with all panelers listed.

Attachments: resume-elena-park.pdf, llm-serving-eval-template.xlsx, interview-slot-options.ics

Thanks — K

--
Kimberly Park

Date: 2027-01-09T10:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Interview playbook + focal areas for LLM Serving Lead candidate (Elena Park)

Kim — thanks for pulling this together. Quick thoughts:
- Swap the order: put implementation/perf earlier (candidate tends to lose detail later in a long loop).
- Add one explicit question about incremental rollout strategies for model changes (gradual traffic shifts, safety checks).
- For the behavioral portion, please probe a candidate-specific example: "Describe a time you debugged a silent regression in production ML infra."

Panel suggestion: I can take the product intro and behavioral; Jonas can do system design; Vivek can do implementation/perf. I'll act as bar-raiser unless we want someone from infra org to do that.

Marissa

Date: 2027-01-10T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Interview playbook + focal areas for LLM Serving Lead candidate (Elena Park)

Thanks — a couple of practical additions from infra ops perspective:
- Add a concrete scoring anchor for "failure-mode design": ask candidate to walk through what they would do if KV cache becomes inconsistent after a canary (probe design, signal thresholds, rollback plan). Score 0-2-4-5 anchors in spreadsheet.
- For perf depth: prefer questions that let candidate sketch micro-optimizations (token-level batching strategy, cache sharding, prefetched KV snapshots).
- Bar-raiser note: look for candid admission of tradeoffs and an ability to quantify impact ("this saved X ms or Y% cost"). If candidate cannot point to measurable impact, discount implementation depth.

I attached a minor edit to the eval template with the failure-mode anchors.

—Vivek
